title: PC·NPC·배경 공통 화풍 재탐색
user_request: 주인공 스타일을 앵커로 안잡아도 되니까 변화를 좀 줘봐
anchor_policy: 기존 도호 이미지의 화풍을 고정하지 않음. 이미지 입력 없이 도호와 NPC 3인, 마을 배경을 세 화풍으로 새로 생성.
identity_scope: 도호의 흑립·남색 도포·붉은 띠·검, NPC 역할/연령/대표 복식, 조선 그루브 판타지 톤을 유지. 새 화풍·얼굴의 채택과 게임 반입은 미확정.

records.title: 먹선 그래픽형
records.review: 각진 얼굴·굵은 먹선·제한색이 인물과 건축에 함께 적용됨. 출력은 요청보다 종이와 석재 질감이 많으므로 선택 시 밀도 조정 대상.
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: S1, a bold ink-and-flat-color art direction exploration for the Korean fantasy action RPG Joseon Hunters. Create one finished 16:9 landscape scene, about 1600 pixels wide. Fresh visual design: invent a NEW shared drawing style for both the protagonist, all NPCs and the entire environment. The protagonist is not a pre-existing style anchor.

Scene and composition: a lively conversation in Motgol, a fictional Korean lakeside village, in clear afternoon daylight. Four full-body adult characters in a loose conversational semicircle around a low dragon-headed granite well. Eye-level medium-wide shot, characters large enough to read their faces and hands, complete hats and feet within frame. Wooden market stall on the left, tiled Korean roofs, a pond and small pavilion behind, restrained background detail. No other people.

Cast: Doho, a tall lean young-adult male wandering sword-wielding Taoist, cheeky sideways smile, black wide-brim cylindrical-crown Korean heukrip with a little blue front ornament and bead cords, navy layered dopo, ivory collar, muted-red waist sash, round blue waist charm, dark boots, a single sheathed sword held casually down at his side, no scarf. Merchant Kim is a stocky older man with a grey moustache, black gat, plain brown vest over ivory clothing, holding a ledger. Shaman Grandma is an elderly woman with a grey hair bun, brick-red jeogori and teal skirt, a folding fan and little brass bells. Village Elder is a tall older man with a long white beard, black gat, plain slate-grey robe and wooden walking staff. Give everyone confident, expressive and age-distinct faces.

ART DIRECTION S1: angular Korean folk graphic novel meets expressive ink printmaking. Bold, variable-width black brush outlines; dramatic wedge-shaped shadow masses; sharply designed angular eyes, noses and cheeks, including Doho; calligraphic flowing robe silhouettes. Five or six solid pigments: ivory paper, ink navy, vermilion, desaturated teal, ochre, warm grey. Slight dry-brush breakup ONLY at selected contour edges, clean interior flat colors, virtually no gradients. Stylize faces, hands, well, roofs, trees and clouds with exactly the same graphic vocabulary. Dynamic witty swagger, adult proportions, strong negative space. This should read immediately as a striking ink-graphic visual redesign, not a conventional delicately shaded anime lineup.
No typography, no labels, no watermark, no photograph textures, no rendered 3D, no excessive glow, no horror, no modern objects.

records.title: 따뜻한 셀 애니형
records.review: 둥근 NPC 얼굴·명료한 셀 그림자·밝은 색으로 구분됨. 도호도 얼굴 비례와 선이 달라졌으며 배경은 인물보다 세밀해 후속 단순화 가능.
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: S2, a warm theatrical cel-animation art direction exploration for the Korean fantasy action RPG Joseon Hunters. One finished 16:9 landscape illustration, about 1600 pixels wide. Create this as a fresh standalone visual design with no image references. Give the protagonist AND the NPCs AND the scenery a newly designed common style.

Scene and composition: a friendly, witty conversation in Motgol, a fictional Korean lakeside village in clear afternoon daylight. Four full-body adults in a loose semicircle around a low dragon-headed granite well. Eye-level medium-wide shot, all hats and feet inside frame, facial expressions readable. Wooden market stall on the left; Korean tiled roofs, leafy trees, a pond and small pavilion behind. No additional people. Keep the composition spacious.

Cast: Doho, a lean young-adult male wandering sword-wielding Taoist with a mischievous crooked smile, black wide-brim cylindrical-crown Korean heukrip with blue ornament and beaded strings, navy layered dopo with ivory collar, muted-red sash and blue round waist charm, dark boots, a single sheathed sword held down at his side, no scarf. Merchant Kim, a round-bodied older man in a black gat, brown vest, ivory shirt and loose trousers, grey moustache, holding a ledger. Shaman Grandma, an elderly woman with a grey bun, brick-red jeogori, teal skirt, folding fan and brass bells. Village Elder, a lanky older man with a long white beard, black gat, plain slate-grey long robe, wooden staff.

ART DIRECTION S2: charming premium hand-drawn feature animation, boldly redesigned expressive adult character proportions, rounded shape language, slightly larger heads with simplified appealing facial construction, Doho as stylized as the elders. 6-head adults rather than miniature children. Smooth, medium-weight deep-blue contours; beautiful economical clean drawings; only two clean hard-edged shadow values; tiny restrained highlights. Warm apricot skin, airy celadon greens and sky blue, creamy ivory, coral-red accents, rich navy Doho silhouette. Broad curved cloth folds and clear hand gestures. Architecture, dragon well, clouds and foliage are equally rounded, simplified and cel-shaded, never realistically painted. Big grouped tree shapes and roofs with only a few designed tile rows. Witty, inviting Korean folk adventure with confident swagger.
An unmistakably colorful, round, clean cel-animation alternative. No crosshatching, no aged-paper texture, no ink splatter, no gritty brushwork, no painterly realism, no 3D render, no glow, no typography, no watermark, no modern objects.

records.title: 거친 붓질형
records.review: 인물·옷·돌·수목에 같은 큰 붓질이 적용됨. 윤곽선 의존도가 낮고 회화성이 강함. 축소 시 얼굴·재질 정보가 뭉칠 수 있어 선택 후 아이소 크기 검수가 필요.
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: S3, an expressive painted art direction exploration for the Korean fantasy action RPG Joseon Hunters. One finished 16:9 landscape scene, about 1600 pixels wide. Fresh standalone generation with no image reference. Completely redesign the rendering of the protagonist as well as the NPCs and scenery into one common PAINTED medium.

Scene and composition: a witty conversation in Motgol, a fictional Korean lakeside village, under clear afternoon daylight. Four full-body adults in a loose conversational semicircle beside a low dragon-headed granite well. Eye-level medium-wide view; all hats and feet inside the frame, faces large and legible. A wooden market stall at left, Korean tiled roofs, pond, distant small pavilion and pine trees behind. No other people.

Characters: Doho, a lean young-adult male wandering sword-bearing Taoist, relaxed crooked smile and strong angled cheekbones, black wide-brim cylindrical-crown Korean heukrip with small blue ornament and beaded cords, navy layered dopo with ivory collar, muted-red sash and round blue waist charm, dark boots, one sheathed sword loosely held down at his side, no scarf. Merchant Kim, a broad older man, grey moustache, black gat, brown vest over ivory clothes, a ledger in hand. Shaman Grandma, an elderly woman with grey hair in a bun, brick-red Korean jeogori, teal skirt, folding fan and brass bells. Village Elder, a tall slender older man, long white beard, black gat, slate-grey robe and wooden staff.

ART DIRECTION S3: vigorous opaque gouache and broad palette-knife-like DIGITAL PAINTING, constructed from confidently visible square and wedge-shaped brush marks. No drawn contours. Every face, including Doho's, is sculpted from a few broad painted planes with small expressive painted eyes, no anime linework. Adult anatomy is deliberately stylized and elongated, not photoreal. Bold simplification, lively asymmetry, expressive gestures, witty Korean folk-adventure swagger. Mostly matte paint, slightly broken edges, energetic brush strokes across skin, hair, clothes, stone, wooden buildings and trees with the SAME brush size logic. Skin planes warm ochre and restrained terracotta, shadows cool violet-blue, deep navy, muted teal, rich cream; clear luminous daylight, strong readable color blocks. Painted background masses quiet enough that faces lead. Warm humanity and confidence, not bleak solemnity. The result must feel like an artist's bravura painted keyframe with an unmistakably different medium from clean cel animation or ink comics.
No thin black outlines, no cel shading, no photo skin, no pores, no individually etched wrinkles, no material grunge overlays, no glossy 3D, no golden halo or bloom, no dark horror, no modern items, no text, no watermarks.
